met_analysis:
The trough in easterlies now runs from southern parts of Lakshadweep to Coastal Karnataka across Eastcentral Arabian Sea at 1.5 km above mean sea level.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over Gujarat & neighbourhood lies over south Gujarat & neighbourhood and extends upto 1.5 km above mean sea level.
An upper air cyclonic circulation lies over southeast Rajasthan & adjoining Madhya Pradesh at 1.5 km above mean sea level.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over Northwest Bay of Bengal and adjoining north Odisha- south Gangetic West Bengal coasts lies over Gangetic West Bengal & neighbourhood at 1.5 km above mean sea level.
An upper air cyclonic circulation is likely to emerge over South Andaman Sea around 29th November 2026.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over South Bangladesh & neighbourhood at 1.5 km above mean sea level has become less marked.
The Western Disturbance as a trough in middle tropospheric westerlies with its axis at 5.8 km above mean sea level roughly along Long. 78°E to the north of Lat. 28°N has moved away in east-northeastwards direction
